overclaims: The main direction of the prediction was borne out: OpenAI raised substantial new funding and large investment firms participated.
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition, conditions and outcome (forecast_outcome, open_horizon, unresolved) all match. The rationale's 'borne out' sentence goes further than the evidence. The contract treats the forecast as one combined claim and flags that 'huge, industry-defining' has no definition. e2 also shows the $6.6B came as convertible notes that depended on restructuring, and the payload leaves that out even though the contract requires separating completed funding from commitments. Citation excerpts are verbatim but very short. e2 cuts out MGX as a state-backed fund.
